sources: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 231880 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20; per-site coordinates from the recreation.gov campsite search API, read 2026-10-26)

values.note: $33 per single site in 2026, and the same in recreation.gov's 2027 table; the group site is $120.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/difficult-campground-and-group-campground ('Single Site: $33 per night', 'Group Site: $120 per night'; last updated May 19, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231880/rates (2026 and 2027 Peak Season: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 33, GROUP 120), read 2026-10-26

values.note: 47 single sites plus a group site (20 people, 10 vehicles). The FS says the sites 'have limited spurs to accommodate trailers up to 40''; the catalog's per-site lengths (20-60 ft) were not used. Five pull-throughs. Vehicles over 35 ft may not cross Independence Pass and must come in from Aspen.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/difficult-campground-and-group-campground ('There are 47 campsites & a group area which can accommodate up to 20 people & 10 vehicles', 'The 47 sites have limited spurs to accommodate trailers up to 40'', 'vehicles over 35 feet in length are prohibited over Independence Pass but can access the campground via Aspen') + campsite catalog for 231880 (Driveway Entry: 5 Pull-Through), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Spigot water is for filling jugs only; RVs may not hook up to it.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/difficult-campground-and-group-campground ('Water, garbage and vault toilets are provided for visitors', 'Potable water is available at this site') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231880 (notice 'RV's and campers cannot hook up to water via the spigots, spigot is for self-fill jugs only'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Reservable on recreation.gov for the 2026 season May 13 - Sept 26 (same dates in 2027), closing 2 days before arrival; every single site is reservable in the catalog. Five-day stay limit (5 nights in any 30). The site must be occupied the first night; campers may be away up to 24 hours. Concession-run (American Land and Leisure).

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231880 (facility_rules maxConsecutiveStay 5, maxStay 5 'Rolling 30 Days', reservationCutOff 2, weekend minimums 0; notices 'Campers must occupy the site the first night', 'Customer Service Contact 801-226-3564 or Help.WhiteRiver.Aspen@AmericanLL.com') + /rates (Peak Season 2026-05-13 to 09-26) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/difficult-campground-and-group-campground ('5 day stay limit') + campsite catalog (all 46 standard sites reservable), read 2026-10-26

note: On the Roaring Fork River 5 mi southeast of Aspen on Hwy 82 (Aspen-Sopris RD, White River NF), 8,180 ft; shaded mixed forest, several sites at the river's edge. Bears visit daily: food lockers, strict storage rules. Day-use area and trailhead on site. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $33 (2026, 2027), no electric, 47 sites, reservable on recreation.gov. Changed max_rig_ft 60 -> 40 (FS 'spurs to accommodate trailers up to 40''; catalog 60 not used). Added pull-throughs, reservable season 05-13 to 09-26, 2-day cutoff, 5-night stay limit, vault toilets, potable water (jugs only). No season statement on the FS page, so season left unknown. No alert affects Hwy 82 or the campground. Note: dropped '~60 ft' and field repeats.
flags: Pin is ~1.5 km off: the entry's location 39.1320,-106.7595 sits southeast of the campground. recreation.gov's 47 campsite coordinates centre on 39.1413,-106.7722 (all within 39.1398-39.1429, -106.7748 to -106.7709); the FS page gives 39.14255,-106.77365. The riverfront call should be re-checked at the corrected pin (waterfront re-audit lead; FS: 'several are at the river's edge').

Entry phone is empty. Concessionaire American Land and Leisure: 801-226-3564 (recreation.gov customer service); recreation.gov facility phone 970-927-0107. Aspen-Sopris Ranger District (970) 963-2266 (fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/offices); the campground page itself lists no phone.
Agency page for the website if wanted: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/difficult-campground-and-group-campground (website is the recreation.gov listing).
